doc: Housing — machine-readable mirror of world/jobs-housing.md §3 + world/housing/. The registry seed in jobs-housing.md is canonical JSON per address spec §4; this file adds listing copy + building card links. Money is game dollars; deed fees are credits (PROPOSAL per monetization §2.4). Lifecycle (application → rent run → notices → disputes → turnover/purchase) lives in world/leases.json + world/lease-ui.md (v12); demo: world/lease.html.

firsts_layer.note: v115 — the first-week layer: one move_ins row per listings_live unit + per listings_ladder tier; a leased unit's row retires as the unit joins homes.json

commute_layer.note: v87 — routes depart from registry unit ids declared here (or 'ambient-ring'); building_pulse says when each address empties and fills

exit_layer.note: v73 — turnover per building: 30-day notice + 21-day deposit clock on registry units, turnover scope, relist path; owner-occupied + ambient-ring rows empty by construction

application_layer.note: v45 — actor-facing viewing/packet/decision/decline per live listing + ladder tier

budget_layer.note: v17 — INTERNAL household envelopes keyed to unit ids; spectator surfaces never render named numbers

market_layer.note: v31 — vacancy lifecycle, days-on-board norms, word-of-mouth room channel, ambient ring, move-in math; INTERNAL tier

grievance_layer.note: the grievance layer (v59) — the informal complaint ladder, per-employer/building ears, the two drop-in tables, rung-5 feed shapes. Content for game-v11 dispute verbs.

home_layer.note: v101 — what each registry unit is like inside: occupants, shape, rota, kitchen, quiet, guests, kit, fridge_note; vacant listings carry showing texture; ambient-ring stays off-registry

offers_layer.note: v129 — the standing-offer layer: one or more bounded opportunities keyed per registry building (bld-* ids from the §3 seed) plus every door venue; quiet visibility = household/handshake knowledge, internal only
